verses.translation: When the earth is shaken violently in its [last] quaking,
when the earth throws out its burdens,
when man cries, ‘What is happening to it?’;
on that Day, it will tell all
because your Lord will inspire it [to do so].

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
verses.translation: On that Day, people will come forward in separate groups to be shown their deeds:

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ
verses.translation: whoever has done an atom’s-weight of good will see it,

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ
verses.translation: but whoever has done an atom’s-weight of evil will see that.
